product.name: Monoprice Commercial Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket Long Extension Range to 3.9 For 13 To 27 TVs up to 33lbs Max VESA 100x100 UL Certified
product.description: Don't leave your flat panel TV on a table or stand where it can be knocked over and damaged, or even worse injure a child or pet. Instead, mount it securely and safely to the wall using this Adjustable Tilting/Swiveling Wall Mount Bracket from Monoprice™!This mount bracket supports adjustments in three dimensions; it can be swiveled ±90°, can be tilted ±20°, and can be rotated ±10°. It also features cable management clips to help keep your installation clean and professional looking. It has undergone extensive safety testing and has been certified by Underwriters Laboratories® (UL®), which ensures that it will perform safely and reliably.This bracket is designed to mount an LCD, LED, or Plasma display with a VESA® mounting pattern of 75x75 or 100x100, which includes most 13" to 27" displays*. It can be mounted to any brick, concrete, or wood stud wall and can safely hold up to 33 lbs. (including the weight of the mount itself). Mounting hardware is included.*The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations. Your TV will work with this mount as long as it has a compatible VESA® pattern and maximum weight.Support Files: User's Manual (Sep 18, 2017)Dimensions Diagram (Sep 18, 2017)Mounting Template (Jul 22, 2024)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
